data.name: Fawz
data.gender_notes: Fawz is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fawz means 'success' or 'victory' in Arabic. It is derived from the root f-w-z, which signifies prosperity and achievement. The name Fawz carries the meaning “Success, Victory” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fawz usually hope their child will grow to embody success, victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Fawz is considered a blessed name, often linked to divine favor and blessings.
data.etymology: Fawz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Success, Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fawz total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
